item.title: India launches anti-dumping probe into nylon chip imports from China, Russia
item.description: Investigation follows complaint by Gujarat Polyfilms alleging dumping of Nylon 6 chips hurting domestic industry

item.title: Swiss ski resort admits safety lapses as probe deepens into fatal New Year fire
item.description: Mayor says Crans-Montana venue had no mandatory annual inspections since 2019; sparkler candles now banned

item.title: Violence marks anti-encroachment demolition drive near Delhi mosque
item.description: Five policemen were injured as an anti-encroachment drive near Delhi’s historic Turkman Gate turned violent early Wednesday, laying bare the clash between civic action, local resistance and unresolved land claims.

item.title: Don’t force BJP to open ‘pages from the past’, Maharashtra minister warns Ajit Pawar
item.description: Maharashtra minister and senior BJP leader Chandrashekhar Bawankule on Tuesday cautioned Deputy Chief Minister Ajit Pawar against criticising the BJP, warning that such attacks could reopen “pages from the past” that no ally would want revisited.

item.title: US seeks to buy Greenland, insists Rubio, amid military option concerns
item.description: The United States is seeking to acquire Greenland through negotiations rather than military force, Secretary of State Marco Rubio told congressional leaders, as tensions over the Arctic territory escalate between Washington, Copenhagen and NATO allies.

item.title: Deadly protests erupt across Iran amid deepening economic crisis
item.description: Iran has been gripped by a new wave of deadly protests as mounting economic distress and public anger spill onto the streets, with clashes between demonstrators and security forces reportedly leaving at least 27 people dead in recent days.

item.title: ECI eases SIR hearings for migrant workers and outstation students in Bengal
item.description: ECI has relaxed SIR norms in West Bengal, allowing migrant workers and outstation students to skip physical hearings, with family members permitted to submit documents on their behalf.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty slip in early trade on geopolitical worries, tariff fears
item.description: Foreign fund outflows add pressure as investors turn cautious amid global uncertainties

item.title: NMC withdraws permission for new medical college in J&K’s Reasi over compliance failures
item.description: MARB orders relocation of 2025–26 MBBS students to other colleges as supernumerary seats after surprise inspection finds major deficiencies

item.title: Lucknow, Ghaziabad among districts with highest uncollected voter forms in UP’s SIR exercise
item.description: Draft electoral roll shows wide district-wise variation as 2.89 crore voters excluded; CEO says figures subject to change after claims period
